tool: Built-in image_gen.imagegen through the imagegen skill; no CLI fallback.
purpose: One shared graphite background for four desktop Home section banners and the Home/Inventory vehicle heroes.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one finished raster background plate reused across four shallow desktop section banners on the existing Auto Best automotive website.
Reference images: the local body-type and brand plates are style references only. Preserve their restrained graphite palette and fine dot motif; make a NEW single common background with calmer flat geometry.
Primary request: a refined matte graphite surface with fine, evenly spaced silver-grey halftone dots at the far left and far right. The dots fade gently toward an entirely smooth dark center. One broad soft neutral studio reflection gives subtle depth at each outside edge. Precise, calm, contemporary automotive visual identity. The repeated dot motif should read clearly at the banner's actual small height without becoming a large perforated grille or a picture of a part.
Composition: panoramic landscape approximately 3:1, about 3072 by 1024. The website crops its middle horizontal band to approximately 1360 by 164. Keep all useful edge detail visible within the middle vertical quarter. Dot fields occupy the outer 22 percent on each side, with balanced visual weight. The center 56 percent stays uninterrupted matte charcoal around #15181d for existing live white heading text and a white button. At edges, restrained lighter graphite around #30353b, tiny silver-grey dots, smooth soft illumination. Use the same material across the entire image, flat front-facing view.
Text: none. BACKGROUND ONLY, one full-bleed plate.
Avoid: vehicles, recognizable car parts, steering wheels, wheels, leather, notebooks, papers, people, logos, text, UI, buttons, curved metal ribbons, folded panels, giant holes, concentric rings, diagonal stripes, carbon-fibre weave, dramatic glows, chrome, neon, gold, blue tint, red lines, smoke, watermark, borders. Do not make four variants or a collage.
delivery: Full-frame WebP quality 84, effort 6. No crop, pixel retouching or compositing.
integration: leadSite.artwork.discoveryBackground owns one URL reused by the four Home section headers and the Home/Inventory cutout heroes from 992px. The two heroes disable their native dots and red-curve decoration through the existing CampaignVehiclePair decoration prop. Mobile does not request this asset. Original vehicle, title and search-control geometry is preserved. Other route hero artwork retains its configured treatment.
runtimeStatus: Active shared discovery background. Separate previous textures remain archived.
